text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
note: fear and timidity

tags.when_helps: A believer held back by fear who needs reminding of the power, love and self-control they have been given.

text: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come. I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
note: facing the end of life with peace

keywords: I have fought the good fight
tags.when_helps: Someone nearing the end of life or of a long work who wants to look back with a sense of having kept faith.

text: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them. But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear; and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
note: abandoned by others; forgiving them

keywords: may it not be held against them
tags.when_helps: A believer deserted by others in a time of need who wants to forgive them and find strength in God.

text: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
note: Wishing wellbeing for body and soul

tags.when_helps: Someone wishing wellbeing for a loved one, or wanting to receive such a blessing.

text: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
note: Choosing good examples, moral choices

tags.when_helps: A believer surrounded by bad examples, deciding whose behaviour to follow.

text: Blot out our iniquities, and do away with our errors, and show forth your compassion in this hour. Let your mercies quickly go before us. Grant us peace, that the cast down and broken hearted may praise you with their mouth.
note: A plea for mercy and peace when broken-hearted

tags.when_helps: A broken-hearted believer asking for mercy and peace after wrongdoing.

text: When Jonah was pining away in the belly of the sea-bred monster, you did look upon him, O Father, and recover him to the sight of his own.
note: Being seen and rescued from the depths of despair

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels swallowed up and unseen, needing to remember that rescue came even from the depths.

text: One may not be able to root out anger from the soul, but it is possible to withstand anger. Any one of you may not be able to eradicate malice, but reasoning has force to work with you to prevent you yielding to malice. For reasoning is not an eradicator, but an antagonist of the passions.
note: anger and resentment; not acting on strong feelings

keywords: reason as antagonist of the passions
tags.when_helps: Someone who can't stop feeling anger but wants to know they can still refuse to act on it.

text: Before pleasure is lust; and after pleasure, joy. And before pain is fear; and after pain is sorrow.
note: understanding desire, fear and sorrow

tags.when_helps: Someone caught in fear before pain, reflecting on how feelings follow one another.

text: For the wise and brave man only is lord over his passions.
note: self-mastery over strong emotions

situations: a habit or addiction I can't break
tags.when_helps: Someone ruled by their impulses who wants a picture of what mastering them takes.

text: The tame birds frequenting the roofs of our houses, defend their fledglings. Others build their nests, and hatch their young, in the tops of mountains and in the precipices of valleys, and the holes and tops of trees, and keep off the intruder. And if not able to do this, they fly circling round them in agony of affection, calling out in their own note, and save their offspring in whatever manner they are able.
note: a parent's protective love and helplessness

tags.when_helps: A parent anxious to protect their child, seeing that fierce instinct mirrored in nature.

text: All who believed were together, and had all things in common. They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need. Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart, praising God, and having favor with all the people.
note: community, sharing, and simple gladness

tags.when_helps: Someone longing for a community that shares and eats together with gladness.

text: For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown. But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!
note: letting time test what lasts; not forcing outcomes

tags.when_helps: A believer anxious about opposing or defending a cause, trusting time to show what is of God.

text: Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism; but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
note: belonging; feeling an outsider; prejudice

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels an outsider by birth or nation, needing to hear that God shows no favouritism.

text: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, neither is he served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all things. He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons, and the boundaries of their dwellings, that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us. ‘For in him we live, and move, and have our being.’
note: Seeking God, feeling far from the divine, shared humanity

keywords: in him we live and move
tags.when_helps: A seeker who feels God is distant, reminded that the divine is not far from anyone.

text: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there; except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me. But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
note: Facing an uncertain, hard future with purpose and courage

tags.when_helps: A believer heading into likely hardship, wanting the resolve to finish their calling with joy.

text: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’
note: Generosity, helping others through one's work

tags.when_helps: Someone weighing whether to give their time or money to people weaker than themselves.

text: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
note: partnership and shared purpose in relationships

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone in a strained partnership or friendship wondering whether they truly share a direction.

text: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say. Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts.
note: choosing goodness and justice as a way to live

tags.when_helps: A believer wanting a clear rule for living rightly and standing up for fairness.

text: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
note: longing for justice and right living

tags.when_helps: Someone angered by injustice who needs a vision of fairness flowing freely and unstoppably.

text: Behold, the days come,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing Yahweh’s words. They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek Yahweh’s word, and will not find it.
note: spiritual hunger and searching for meaning

tags.when_helps: A believer feeling spiritually starved, searching everywhere for meaning and finding none.

text: O Lord Almighty, you God of Israel, the soul in anguish, the troubled spirit, cries to you.
note: anguish and a troubled spirit crying out

tags.when_helps: A believer in anguish who needs simple words to cry out with, knowing others have prayed the same.

text: Learn where is wisdom, where is strength, where is understanding; that you may know also where is length of days, and life, where is the light of the eyes, and peace.
note: seeking wisdom, strength and peace

tags.when_helps: Someone searching for direction who is invited to seek wisdom, strength and peace.

text: Where are the princes of the heathen, and such as ruled the beasts that are upon the earth; those who had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and those who hoarded up silver and gold, wherein men trust; and of whose getting there is no end? For those who wrought in silver, and were so careful, and whose works are past finding out, they are vanished and gone down to the grave, and others are come up in their steads.
note: wealth and power pass away; ambition and mortality

tags.when_helps: Someone consumed by wealth or status who needs to remember that the mighty have all vanished.

text: Go your way, O my children, go your way: for I am left desolate. I have put off the garment of peace, and put upon me the sackcloth of my petition: I will cry to the Everlasting as long as I live.
note: parent's grief at children leaving; desolation

tags.when_helps: A parent left desolate as their children go, who turns their sorrow into lifelong prayer.

text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
note: lifting attention above daily worries

tags.when_helps: A believer preoccupied with earthly worries or wants who needs to lift their focus.

text: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance; bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do. Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection. And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
note: forgiveness, compassion, patience with others

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: A Christian with a complaint against someone who needs to put on patience, forgive and walk in love.

text: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
note: parenting without discouraging children

tags.when_helps: A parent whose irritation may be discouraging their child and who needs reminding to be gentle.

text: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men, knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
note: meaning in work, working wholeheartedly

keywords: work heartily, as for the Lord
tags.when_helps: A believer whose work goes unappreciated who needs a reason to work wholeheartedly anyway.

text: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time. Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
note: gracious speech, wise use of time

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone unsure how to speak to people who see things differently who wants to answer with grace.

text: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his. He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings, and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding. He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.
note: Change and uncertainty; light present even in darkness

tags.when_helps: A believer unsettled by change or uncertainty who finds steadiness in praising a God who knows the hidden things.

text: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter. If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”
note: Standing by conviction under pressure, whatever the outcome

tags.when_helps: A believer pressured to betray their convictions who needs courage to stand firm whatever the outcome.

text: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me. He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me.”
note: Fear and exhaustion met with reassurance; regaining strength

tags.when_helps: Someone frightened and drained who needs a gentle word of strength and to hear they are beloved.

text: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.
note: Lasting worth of wisdom and helping others do good

tags.when_helps: Someone who works quietly to help others find their way and wonders whether it matters.

text: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
note: Overwhelm from carrying others' burdens alone

situations: caring for a sick or ageing relative
tags.when_helps: Someone carrying everyone else's problems alone who feels the load has become too much for one person.

text: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s.
note: Fairness; not fearing others' opinion when deciding

tags.when_helps: Someone who must judge fairly between people and is afraid of displeasing the powerful.

text: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hand. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
note: Looking back on long hardship with gratitude

tags.when_helps: A believer looking back on a long hard stretch who needs to see they were provided for throughout.

text: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one. You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
note: Wholehearted devotion; loving with all of oneself

tags.when_helps: A believer wanting to recommit wholeheartedly to loving God with everything they have.

text: You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to prove you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments, or not. He humbled you, and allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know; that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.
note: Hard seasons as teachers; meaning beyond material need

tags.when_helps: A believer in a long lean season who wants to see hardship as a time of being led and taught.

text: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.
note: Hardship understood as loving correction

keywords: as a man disciplines his son
tags.when_helps: A believer going through hardship who could understand it as loving correction rather than abandonment.

text: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
note: What a faithful life asks; purpose and devotion

tags.when_helps: A believer unsure what is asked of them who wants a simple summary of a faithful life.

text: For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods, and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons, nor takes reward. He does execute justice for the fatherless and widow, and loves the foreigner, in giving him food and clothing. Therefore love the foreigner; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
note: Compassion for outsiders, remembering one's own displacement

tags.when_helps: A believer who is a stranger or widow, or cares for one, wanting assurance that God defends the vulnerable.

text: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother; but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.
note: Generosity toward someone in need; not hardening the heart

tags.when_helps: A believer tempted to shut their hand to someone in need who needs a call to open-handed generosity.

text: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him; because that for this thing Yahweh your God will bless you in all your work, and in all that you put your hand to. For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.
note: Giving freely without resentment

tags.when_helps: A believer who gives grudgingly and wants to learn to give gladly, without a grieving heart.

text: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise, and perverts the words of the righteous. You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live, and inherit the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
note: Integrity, fairness, resisting corruption

tags.when_helps: Someone with power to judge others who is tempted toward favouritism and needs a firm call to fairness.

text: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for Yahweh your God is with you, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
note: Facing overwhelming odds without fear

tags.when_helps: A believer facing a confrontation where they feel badly outnumbered, needing courage that God is with them.

text: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.
note: Not looking away when someone needs help

tags.when_helps: Someone hesitating to get involved when a neighbour or relative is struggling, needing a nudge to help.

text: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God as a freewill offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.
note: Keeping one's word and promises

tags.when_helps: A believer wavering on a promise made to God who needs reminding to keep their word.

text: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers, or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates. In his day you shall give him his hire, neither shall the sun go down on it; for he is poor, and sets his heart on it; lest he cry against you to Yahweh, and it be sin to you.
note: Fair treatment of workers; paying people promptly

tags.when_helps: A worker treated unfairly over pay, or an employer tempted to delay it, who needs a clear word on justice.

text: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow; that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
note: Leaving room for others; generosity from abundance

tags.when_helps: A grateful believer with plenty who wants a practical image of leaving something for those in need.

text: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life. In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.
note: Restless anxiety and dread; part of a curse list

tags.when_helps: Someone living in constant fear, wishing each day and night away, who needs to know this state has been described before.

text: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.
note: Accepting what cannot be known; acting on what is clear

tags.when_helps: Someone tormented by unanswerable questions who could rest in doing what is known and leaving the unknown alone.

text: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant. It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, and bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?” Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, and bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?” But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
note: What is right is within reach, not far away

tags.when_helps: Someone who feels the right path is out of reach, needing reminding it is already within them.

text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants; to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days; that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
note: Decisions; choosing life and what sustains it

tags.when_helps: A believer at a crossroads between ways of living who needs a clear call to choose life.

text: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.
note: Facing the unknown; not being alone in fear

tags.when_helps: A believer facing something new and frightening who needs assurance they will not be abandoned.

text: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms.
note: Being held and supported in weakness or grief

tags.when_helps: A believer who feels unsupported and needs the image of being held from beneath.

text: As your days, so your strength will be.
note: Strength given equal to each day's demands

tags.when_helps: Someone afraid they will not have strength for what lies ahead, reminded that strength comes day by day.

text: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing. That which has been is that which shall be; and that which has been done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
note: weariness, restlessness, feeling nothing ever changes

tags.when_helps: Someone weary of sameness and never feeling satisfied, who wants that weariness named honestly.

text: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.
note: accepting what cannot be fixed

situations: loss of a dream or plan
tags.when_helps: Someone straining to fix what cannot be fixed, needing to accept limits.

text: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind. For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
note: knowledge bringing sorrow, overthinking

tags.when_helps: Someone whose learning has brought more sorrow than peace, feeling the weight of seeing too much.

text: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor. Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.
note: emptiness after success and achievement

tags.when_helps: Someone who got what they worked and wished for and finds it hollow.

text: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.
note: finding contentment in simple pleasures and work

tags.when_helps: Someone grinding through work who could let themselves enjoy simple pleasures as a gift.

text: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted; a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up; a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance; a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing; a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away; a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak; a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
note: change, seasons of life, grief and joy

tags.when_helps: Someone in a painful season of life, reminded that every season, sorrowful or joyful, has its time.

text: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
note: overwork, ambition versus peace

tags.when_helps: Someone overworked and chasing more, invited to choose less with peace.

text: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then, do I labor, and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
note: loneliness and endless work without purpose

tags.when_helps: Someone working endlessly and alone, starting to ask who all this effort is for.

text: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up. Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone? If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
note: friendship, companionship, loneliness

tags.when_helps: Someone trying to go it alone who needs a reminder of the strength of companionship.

text: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he who loves abundance, with increase: this also is vanity. When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes? The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.
note: money, greed, restlessness of wealth

keywords: the sleep of a laboring man
tags.when_helps: Someone always wanting more money, noticing that more never satisfies or brings rest.

text: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
note: contentment with what is in front of you

tags.when_helps: Someone always wanting what they do not have, invited to value what is before them.

text: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart. Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good. The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
note: grief and mortality deepening the heart

tags.when_helps: Someone attending a funeral or sitting with sorrow, finding that it can deepen and teach them.

text: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit. Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools. Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.
note: patience, anger, nostalgia for the past

tags.when_helps: Someone pining for the good old days or quick to anger, urged toward patience.

text: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.
note: good times and hard times side by side

keywords: day of prosperity, day of adversity
tags.when_helps: Someone in a hard stretch, or a good one, reminded that both come side by side.

text: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth, who does good and doesn’t sin. Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you; for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.
note: imperfection, criticism, gossip about you

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone stung by what someone said behind their back, reminded that they have done the same.

text: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works. Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil. Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity: for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun. Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
note: enjoying life and love while you have it

tags.when_helps: Someone hesitant to enjoy life, encouraged to savour food, love and work wholeheartedly while they can.

text: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
note: unfairness, luck, effort not rewarded

keywords: the race is not to the swift
tags.when_helps: Someone who did everything right and still lost out, recognising the role of time and chance.

text: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.
note: an angry boss, gentleness in conflict

tags.when_helps: Someone whose boss or authority figure is angry at them, tempted to walk out.

text: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap. As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all. In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.
note: indecision, waiting for certainty, acting anyway

tags.when_helps: Someone waiting for perfect conditions before acting, urged to sow now without knowing the outcome.

text: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to see the sun. Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes is vanity.
note: savouring life, ageing, remembering hard days

tags.when_helps: Someone enjoying a good stretch of life, mindful that darker days also come.

text: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath, and don’t give place to the devil.
note: anger that is not let fester

tags.when_helps: A believer passing through a season of tears who wants to see it can become a place of springs.

note: Drinking in moderation versus excess

situations: a habit or addiction I can't break
tags.when_helps: Someone enjoying a drink or celebrating who wants to keep pleasure from turning into bitterness and conflict.

text: Speak, young man, if there be need of you; Yet scarcely if you be twice asked. Sum up your speech, many things in few words; Be as one that knows and yet holds his tongue.
note: Speaking briefly; restraint when young or new

situations: a career change or new job
tags.when_helps: A young or new person unsure when to speak up, looking for counsel on brevity and restraint.

text: Do nothing without counsel; And when you have once done, repent not.
note: Making decisions carefully, then not second-guessing

tags.when_helps: Someone agonising over a decision, or second-guessing one already made, who needs to seek advice then let it rest.

text: Vain and false hopes are for a man void of understanding; And dreams give wings to fools. As one that catches at a shadow, and follows after the wind, So is he that sets his mind on dreams.
note: Chasing false hopes and fantasies

situations: loss of a dream or plan
tags.when_helps: Someone pinning everything on fanciful hopes who might benefit from a sober reminder to stay grounded.

text: A well-instructed man knows many things; And he that has much experience will declare understanding. He that has no experience knows few things: But he that has wandered shall increase his skill. In my wandering I have seen many things; And more than my words is my understanding. Ofttimes was I in danger even to death; And I was preserved because of these things.
note: Learning from experience, travel and hardship

tags.when_helps: Someone who has wandered or faced danger and wonders what it was for; their experience has become understanding.

text: Every friend will say, I also am his friend: But there is a friend, which is only a friend in name. Is there not a grief in it even to death, When a companion and friend is turned to enmity?
note: Betrayal by a friend; false friendship

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone hurt by a friend who has turned against them.

text: Forget not a friend in your soul; And be not unmindful of him in your riches.
note: Remembering friends when life goes well

tags.when_helps: Someone whose fortunes have risen, reminded not to forget friends who were there before.

text: And make the counsel of your heart to stand; For there is none more faithful to you than it. For a man’s soul is sometime wont to bring him tidings, More than seven watchmen that sit on high on a watch-tower.
note: Trusting your own inner judgement in decisions

tags.when_helps: Someone torn between others' advice who needs to trust their own inner counsel.

text: Let reason be the beginning of every work, And let counsel go before every action.
note: Thinking before acting; decisions

tags.when_helps: Someone about to act on impulse who could pause to think it through first.

text: My son, prove your soul in your life, And see what is evil for it, and give not that to it. For all things are not profitable for all men, Neither has every soul pleasure in every thing.
note: Knowing what is good for you; self-knowledge

situations: a habit or addiction I can't break
tags.when_helps: Someone learning which pleasures harm them and choosing not to indulge them.

text: My son, let your tears fall over the dead, And as one that suffers grievously begin lamentation; And wind up his body according to his due, And neglect not his burial. Make bitter weeping, and make passionate wailing, And let your mourning be according to his desert, For one day or two, lest you be evil spoken of: And so be comforted for your sorrow.
note: Permission to mourn a death fully

tags.when_helps: Someone newly bereaved who needs permission to mourn fully and then to be comforted.

text: Give not your heart to sorrow: Put it away, remembering the last end: Forget it not, for there is no returning again: Him you shall not profit, and you will hurt yourself. Remember the sentence upon him; for so also shall your be; Yesterday for me, and today for you. When the dead is at rest, let his remembrance rest; And be comforted for him, when his spirit departs from him.
note: Grief that lingers too long; letting the dead rest

keywords: yesterday for me, today for you
tags.when_helps: Someone whose grief has gone on long and is hurting them, encouraged to let the dead rest.

text: There is wrath, and jealousy, and trouble, and disquiet, And fear of death, and anger, and strife; And in the time of rest upon his bed His night sleep does change his knowledge. A little or nothing is his resting, And afterward in his sleep, as in a day of keeping watch, He is troubled in the vision of his heart, As one that has escaped from the front of battle. In the very time of his deliverance he awakens, And marvels that the fear is nothing.
note: Night anxiety and sleepless fear that proves empty

tags.when_helps: Someone whose worries chase them into sleepless or troubled nights, who may find the fear was nothing.

text: The life of one that labores, and is contented, shall be made sweet; And he that finds a treasure is above both.
note: Contentment in honest work

tags.when_helps: Someone working hard for modest return, reminded that contentment makes such a life sweet.

text: Wine and music rejoice the heart; And the love of wisdom is above both.
note: Pleasure versus the deeper joy of wisdom

tags.when_helps: Someone enjoying life's pleasures who might value the love of wisdom even more.

text: Don’t be afraid of the sentence of death; Remember those who have been before you, and that come after: This is the sentence from the Lord over all flesh. And why do you refuse, when it is the good pleasure of the Most High? Whether it be ten, or a hundred, or a thousand years, There is no inquisition of life in the grave.
note: Fear of death; mortality shared by all

tags.when_helps: Someone afraid of their own death who could find steadiness in its being shared by everyone.

text: Have regard to your name; For it continueth with you longer than a thousand great treasures of gold. A good life has its number of days; And a good name continueth forever.
note: Reputation and legacy outlasting wealth

tags.when_helps: Someone tempted to trade their good name for wealth, reminded which lasts longer.

text: My children, keep instruction in peace: But wisdom that is hid, and a treasure that is not seen, What profit is in them both? Better is a man that hides his foolishness Than a man that hides his wisdom.
note: Sharing your gifts rather than hiding them

tags.when_helps: Someone who holds back what they know out of shyness, urged to share it.

text: A mist coming speedily is the healing of all things; A dew coming after heat shall bring cheerfulness.
note: Relief arriving after a hard, scorching time

tags.when_helps: Someone worn out by a hard stretch who needs a gentle image of coming relief.

text: We may say many things, yet shall we not attain; And the sum of our words is, He is all.
note: Limits of words before the divine; humility

tags.when_helps: Someone at the limits of words before the divine.

text: My soul drew near even to death, And my life was near to the grave beneath. They compassed me on every side, And there was none to help me. I was looking for the succour of men, And it was not. And I remembered your mercy, O Lord, And your working which has been from everlasting, How you deliver those who wait for you, And save them out of the hand of the enemies.
note: Feeling abandoned by everyone; finding hope in prayer

tags.when_helps: Someone near the edge with no one to help, reminded that crying out to God has brought deliverance before.

text: When I was yet young, Or ever I went abroad, I sought wisdom openly in my prayer. Before the temple I asked for her, And I will seek her out even to the end. From her flower as from the ripening grape my heart delighted in her: My foot trod in uprightness, From my youth I tracked her out. I bowed down my ear a little, and received her, And found for myself much instruction.
note: A lifelong search for wisdom

keywords: from her flower as from the ripening grape
tags.when_helps: Someone drawn to a lifelong search for wisdom who finds delight in pursuing it.

text: Work your work before the time comes, And in his time he will give you your reward.
note: Doing your work now; patience for reward

tags.when_helps: Someone unsure whether their effort will pay off, urged to do the work now and trust the reward.

text: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, or by the hinds of the field, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
note: not rushing love before its time

tags.when_helps: Someone eager to rush into romance, counselled to let love unfold in its own time.

text: My beloved spoke, and said to me, “Rise up, my love, my beautiful one, and come away. For, behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone. The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land. The fig tree ripens her green figs. The vines are in blossom. They give out their fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.”
note: a hard season ending, love and renewal

tags.when_helps: Someone in love or emerging from a hard season, ready to feel spring and renewal.

text: By night on my bed, I sought him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him. I will get up now, and go about the city; in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but I didn’t find him.
note: longing for an absent loved one

tags.when_helps: Someone lying awake searching for a loved one they cannot reach.

text: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine.
note: mutual belonging in love

tags.when_helps: Someone treasuring a mutual, secure love with a partner.

text: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of Yahweh. Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.
note: the strength of love; love can't be bought

tags.when_helps: Someone feeling the full force of love and wanting words for how unquenchable and priceless it is.

work: Song of the Three Young Men
display: Song of the Three Young Men 1:18
text: And now we follow you with all our heart, we fear you, and seek your face. Put us not to shame: but deal with us after your kindness, and according to the multitude of your mercy.
note: Shame and guilt; asking for mercy and a fresh start

tags.when_helps: A believer who fears disgrace and wants to commit wholeheartedly while asking for mercy.

work: Song of the Three Young Men
display: Song of the Three Young Men 1:67
text: O give thanks to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endures forever.
note: Gratitude; trust in enduring mercy

tags.when_helps: A believer feeling thankful who wants a simple line of praise.

text: To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
note: how our inner state colours what we see

keywords: to the pure all things are pure
tags.when_helps: Someone who sees corruption everywhere and needs to consider how their own mind colours what they see.

text: Don’t despise your mother. Honor her all the days of your life, and do that which is pleasing to her, and don’t grieve her. Remember, my child, that she has seen many dangers for you, when you were in her womb.
note: honoring and caring for one's mother

situations: caring for a sick or ageing relative
tags.when_helps: Someone with a strained or neglected relationship with their mother, reconsidering what they owe her.

text: Give alms from your possessions. When you give alms, don’t let your eye be envious. Don’t turn away your face from any poor man, and the face of God won’t be turned away from you. As your possessions are, give alms of it according to your abundance. If you have little, don’t be afraid to give alms according to that little; for you lay up a good treasure for yourself against the day of necessity; because alms-giving delivers from death, and doesn’t allow you to come into darkness.
note: generosity, even when you have little

tags.when_helps: Someone worried about money who hesitates to give, wondering whether a small gift is worth anything.

text: And what you yourself hate, do to no man.
note: treating others as you wish to be treated

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone tempted to treat another person badly, needing a simple test for how to act.

text: Ask counsel of every man who is wise, and don’t despise any counsel that is profitable.
note: seeking good advice when making decisions

tags.when_helps: Someone facing a decision alone and reluctant to ask others for advice.

text: And fear not, my child, because we are made poor. You have much wealth, if you fear God, and depart from all sin, and do that which is pleasing in his sight.”
note: facing poverty; true wealth is goodness

tags.when_helps: A believer frightened by sudden poverty, needing to hear that their real wealth lies elsewhere.

text: Don’t be greedy to add money to money; but let it be as refuse compared to our child. For what the Lord has given us to live is enough for us.”
note: contentment; family matters more than money

tags.when_helps: A parent tempted to chase money at the cost of their family, reminded that what they have is enough.

text: Do good, and evil won’t find you. Good is prayer with fasting, alms, and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold.
note: integrity over wealth; generosity

tags.when_helps: Someone torn between gain and goodness who needs a reminder that a little honestly held beats much.

text: Beware then of unprofitable murmuring, And refrain your tongue from backbiting; Because no secret utterance will go on its way void, And a mouth that belies destroys a soul.
note: Gossip, complaining and the harm of careless words

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone tempted to grumble or gossip about others who needs a warning to hold their tongue.

text: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, And no torment will touch them. In the eyes of the foolish they seemed to have died; And their departure was accounted to be their hurt, And their journeying away from us to be their ruin: But they are in peace.
note: Grief for the dead; consolation that they are at peace

tags.when_helps: A believer mourning someone good who needs to trust they are now at peace.

text: But a righteous man, though he die before his time, will be at rest. (For honorable old age is not that which stands in length of time, Nor is its measure given by number of years: But understanding is gray hairs to men, And an unspotted life is ripe old age.)
note: Grief over early death; a life measured by quality

tags.when_helps: Someone grieving a person who died young, consoled that a life's worth is not measured in years.

text: Wisdom is radiant and fades not away; And easily is she saw those who love her, And found of those who seek her. She forestalleth those who desire to know her, making herself first known. He that rises up early to seek her will have no toil, For he will find her sitting at his gates. For to think upon her is perfectness of understanding, And he that watches for her sake will quickly be free from care.
note: Seeking wisdom; wisdom is near to those who look

tags.when_helps: Someone searching for wisdom who is told it is near to those who seek it.

text: I myself also am mortal, like to all, And am sprung from one born of the earth, the man first formed, And in the womb of a mother was I moulded into flesh in the time of ten months, Being compacted in blood of the seed of man and pleasure that came with sleep. And I also, when I was born, drew in the common air, And fell upon the kindred earth, Uttering, like all, for my first voice, the selfsame wail: In swaddling clothes was I nursed, and with watchful cares. For no king had any other first beginning; But all men have one entrance into life, and a like departure.
note: Humility; shared mortality of the great and small

tags.when_helps: Someone feeling either above or below others who is reminded all share the same birth and death.

text: For what man will know the counsel of God? Or who will conceive what the Lord willeth? For the thoughts of mortals are timorous, And our plans are prone to fail. For a corruptible body weighs down the soul, And the earthy frame lies heavy on a mind that is full of cares. And hardly do we divine the things that are on earth, And the things that are close at hand we find with labor; But the things that are in the heavens who ever yet traced out?
note: Uncertainty, failed plans and the limits of understanding

keywords: our plans are prone to fail
tags.when_helps: Someone anxious that their plans may fail who can rest in the limits of human understanding.

text: For you love all things that are, And abhor none of the things which you did make; For never would you have formed anything if you did hate it. And how would anything have endured, except you had willed it? Or that which was not called by you, how would it have been preserved? But you spare all things, because they are your, O Soverign Lord, you lover of men’s lives; For your incorruptible spirit is in all things.
note: Feeling unloved or worthless; everything that exists is loved

keywords: you love all things that are
tags.when_helps: A believer who feels unloved or unworthy, reminded that God loves all that exists.

text: For wickedness, condemned by a witness within, is a coward thing, And, being pressed hard by conscience, always forecasts the worst lot: For fear is nothing else but a surrender of the help which reason offers; And from within the heart the expectation of them being less Maketh of greater account the ignorance of the cause that brings the torment.
note: Guilty conscience and fear; fear as abandoning reason

tags.when_helps: Someone whose guilty conscience feeds constant fear of the worst.

text: This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
note: strength that does not come from force or power

keywords: not by might nor by power
tags.when_helps: A believer facing a task beyond their strength who needs to trust it does not rest on their power alone.

text: Indeed, who despises the day of small things?
note: valuing small beginnings and modest progress

tags.when_helps: Someone embarrassed by how small their start looks who needs to value modest beginnings.

text: Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother. Don’t oppress the widow, nor the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’
note: kindness, compassion and fairness toward others

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
tags.when_helps: Someone wanting a clear standard of fairness and kindness, especially toward the vulnerable.

text: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates, and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate,” says Yahweh.
note: honesty and goodwill toward neighbors

situations: conflict with a friend or colleague
keywords: speak the truth to your neighbour
tags.when_helps: Someone tempted to deceive or scheme against a neighbour who needs a plain call to honesty.

text: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
note: holding on to hope; restoration after loss

situations: loss of a dream or plan
tags.when_helps: A believer who feels trapped by hardship but still clings to hope and needs it confirmed.

text: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
note: being loved, calmed and delighted in

tags.when_helps: A believer feeling anxious or unloved who needs to hear God delights in them and calms them.
